test_title: PYST 93: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 07 Mar, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Five persons A, B, C, D and E are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). C is not an immediate neighbour of A. B is sitting second to the left of E. A is sitting second to the right of E. Who is sitting on the immediate left of C?
solution:
Given: Five persons A, B, C, D and E.

1) B is sitting second to the left of E.

2) A is sitting second to the right of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7100568049dbb64b5cb0da57d4f02ee99d5cadc414d96586f11cf5eb8c3d5d6a.png] 

3) C is not an immediate neighbour of A.

Final arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3d7791904d17d79106ce05f29671bb3cdc748fbefb31c907f04228ecc9eebc2.png] 

So, **B **is sitting on the immediate left of C.

Hence, the correct answer is "**B**".
